cases.description: The R4 of dealers 1-3 are missing. Reconstructing them would leave two of the five QUAL dealers, fewer than t = 3, so the ceremony stops after R5 and no R6 round exists.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_reconstruction_floor

cases.description: Member 1's R4 is missing from closed R4, so dealer 1 is reconstructed and member 1 stops after R5. An R6 from member 1 is closed anyway; it contributes no values, and the outputs equal those of the next case apart from the transcript hash.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_r6_from_member_without_r4

cases.description: The previous case without member 1's R6: dealer 1 is reconstructed from the R6 of members 2-5.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_member_without_r4_sends_no_r6

cases.description: Member 1 has two different R5 in closed R5 and stops after R5. An R6 from member 1 is closed anyway and contributes no values; dealer 5 is reconstructed from the R6 of members 2-5.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_r6_from_member_with_two_r5

cases.description: Member 1's R4 is missing, and only members 2 and 3 send R6 besides member 1. Member 1's R6 contributes no values, so two eligible values remain for dealer 1, fewer than t = 3.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_ineligible_r6_leaves_fewer_than_t_values

cases.description: Dealer 5's R4 is chosen after the other R4 so that mpk is a fixed point; it passes the checks of honest members 1 and 2 only. Honest member 3's R5 is omitted and it stops after R5; faulty members 4 and 5 send empty R5 and may claim readiness without a matching share. The transcript verifies with nothing reconstructed.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_chosen_master_key

cases.description: Activation of the genesis certificate over the transcript of genesis_3of5_chosen_master_key with members 1, 2, 4 and 5 ready and an outage budget of 1. A genesis or re-key candidate needs a budget of at least f = 2 for 3-of-5.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_chosen_master_key_activation_budget_1

cases.description: The same genesis activation with an outage budget of 2 needs t + 2 = 5 ready members; four are ready.
cases.name: genesis_3of5_chosen_master_key_activation_budget_2

cases.description: 2-of-3: dealers 2 and 3 publish no R1, so QUAL is dealer 1 alone after R3, fewer than t = 2. A validly signed closed R4 carrying member 1's signed R4 follows. The verifier returns InsufficientQualified after R3 without reading any later record.
cases.name: genesis_insufficient_qualified_with_trailing_r4

cases.description: The previous case with the R4 closure signature replaced by junk bytes. The R4 record is never authenticated, so the result is still InsufficientQualified.
cases.name: genesis_insufficient_qualified_with_bad_r4

encoding: hex; statements are exact signed bytes; scalars 32-byte big-endian; G2 96-byte compressed; certificates are the canonical body plus the owner signature; re-key cases carry the pinned current certificate
suite: BLS12-381 G2 Pedersen/Feldman GJKR New-DKG under genesis and re-key ceremonies: own-message presence, the R6 reconstruction floor and the genesis/re-key activation budget; Ed25519 test signatures
